Salary and pay

ItemDetail
Pay levelLevel-2 of the 7th CPC pay matrix
Starting basic payRs 19,900 (Advt. 02/2026)
Pay scale (reported)Rs 19,900-63,200
During probationthe minimum of the scale, as for other new Punjab government recruits

Allowances and in-hand pay depend on the department and the posting city, so treat any in-hand figure you see online as an estimate.
